title: COVID-19 Vaccination Roll-out for Migrant Workers
what_it_is: COVID-19 Vaccination Roll-out for Migrant Workers

sections.label: Migrant worker dorm vaccination plans
sections.summary: MOM and MOH are planning migrant worker vaccination with a communication campaign explaining vaccine safety, side effects and allergic reaction risks in native languages.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The communal living and working conditions of migrant workers in dormitories put them at higher risk of infection and the formation of large clusters.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM is working out the schedule and details with MOH, depending on the delivery schedule for the vaccines.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We will make an announcement when it is ready.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: I can share that the vaccination efforts will be accompanied by a very comprehensive communication campaign to inform migrant workers of the safety and benefits of the vaccine.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The common side effects as well as the risks of allergic reactions will also be explained and communication with the migrant workers will be done through videos, pamphlets as well as booklets in their native languages.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Vaccination of the migrant workers helps to reduce the viral load which, in turn, lowers the overall risk and helps protect our wider community from an outbreak.

sections.label: Prioritising migrant workers and NGOs
sections.summary: Migrant workers will be prioritised within the communicated timeline, with higher-risk dorms vaccinated first and work with larger NGOs for outreach.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Yes, the answer to his first question is yes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We will prioritise the migrant workers and it would be within the timeline as communicated by the Senior Minister of State.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: However, the prioritisation will also depend on the risk stratification of the dorms and obviously those at higher risk, we will vaccinate them first.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: With regard to the NGOs, we will be working with some of the larger NGOs which have greater outreach in terms of reaching out to the migrant workers.
